text: {"findings":[{"rule":"J1","where":"Deployment._configureModules (overrides BaseSetup._configureModules)","severity":"HIGH","why":"The override calls only _setCap, so addCountryRestriction(408) is never run on countryModule. Country 408 is not restricted, so the country module approves transfers to investors registered in 408.","steps":"1) Investor c is registered with country 408 and holds a valid KYC claim, so isVerified(c) is true. 2) Agent or holder calls token.transfer(c, amount) (or mint(c, amount)). 3) countryModule.moduleCheck returns true because isCountryRestricted(compliance, 408) is false, so the transfer succeeds."},{"rule":"J2","where":"IdentityRegistry.updateCountry with Deployment._configureModules","severity":"HIGH","why":"Because 408 is missing from the country module's restricted list, a wallet moved to 408 by updateCountry still passes the country check and can receive tokens.","steps":"1) Agent calls ir.updateCountry(a1, 408). 2) Holder calls token.transfer(a1, amount). 3) countryModule.moduleCheck sees an unrestricted country and returns true, so the transfer succeeds."},{"rule":"J3","where":"Deployment._configureModules (setup override)","severity":"HIGH","why":"The country module is bound to the compliance contract, but the restricted-country set is empty for this deployment, so the country restriction is not in effect. The override removed the _restrictCountry(RESTRICTED) step from the base setup.","steps":"1) Setup runs Deployment._configureModules, which calls only _setCap(CAP). 2) countryModule.isCountryRestricted(compliance, 408) returns false. 3) The country restriction has no effect on transfers or mints."}]}
